grades.overall_note: The agent handled this well. It saw that the landlord had already been asked in event 020 and did not send a duplicate. It held the ticket, scheduled a chase, updated the tenant, and refused to approve the spend. Two small gaps: the work record leaves out the water in the base, and the agent did not ask the engineer for written findings or a photo.
